productDecides: whether the consumer is authorized (it is handed only an AUTHORIZED Capsule)
hostDecides: only WHERE the already-qualified section appears in the actual UserMessage
hostDoesNotDecide: its own historical Attempt or Session

modes.OFF: no presentation at all (null); a default deployment's prompt is byte-identical to the baseline
modes.CONTROL: the SAME section boundary as TREATMENT and NO invented history — no SessionId, Result, Verification, Failure or Promotion
modes.TREATMENT: the ACTUAL qualified, Attempt-bound Capsule rendered under the frozen format

sectionStructure: AUTHORITY LIMITATION (the Capsule's own doesNotAuthorize list)

budgets.policy: a caller may lower the section budget, never raise the ceiling; an over-budget TREATMENT is DELIVERY_PRECONDITION_NOT_MET rather than a truncated section
budgets.why: a Capsule can satisfy its own serialized-byte limit while a verbose renderer produces a much larger section, so the section has its own measured budget

digests.capsuleDigest: canonical SHA-256 of the Capsule value
digests.sectionDigest: canonical SHA-256 of the rendered section text
digests.note: a Capsule digest does NOT prove section delivery, so the two are recorded separately and never conflated

expectedInvariant: a pure controlled renderer produces stable, bounded OFF/CONTROL/TREATMENT behavior without changing any execution authority
remainingUncertainty: the renderer proves what the PRODUCT would place; it does not prove the Host placed it (C4) or that a model read it (out of scope, L3)
